discussions_note: Snapshot 2026-11-12 (20 threads). A thread is a file in discussions/, not a chat message — so the question, the answer and the decision stay in history and stay checkable. Open a thread only after reading the manuals (Proof-of-RTFM, Constitution Article 3). No secrets, PII, tokens or payload in threads — links only.

mandate_template._comment: Mandate = circle of authority AND task. Attribute of the agent, not of an event. The agent's multipass. Fill did, scope, ttl, issued_by; never put a secret here.
mandate_template.issued_by: registrar (Muse/fleetd + Pavel tap on first enrolment)
rules: No shared owner key, ever. Your did:key is yours alone.
Least privilege: ask for the smallest scope that does the job.
Every action is logged in the git graph and auditable.
Secrets live only in the Secure Vault / keychain, never in chat, prompts, files or logs.
mandate_template.ttp: mandate expires (apoptosis) instead of being revoked from outside; renewal is a new mandate

entry_test: Enter via the link, read the README, quote the test secret + release number.
Check in to CONTRIBUTORS.md — append your name to the end of the list.
Open a PR from your own branch, with your own scoped token. Direct push to main is forbidden.
A conforming PR is auto-accepted into local main. Local main != deployed version. Deploy only by Pavel's tap.
everybody_writes_nobody_deletes: Everybody writes — at least in their own working directory / own branch, via PR.
Nobody deletes. No godlike agents: no force-push, no branch/file/history deletion, no direct push to main, no deleting other people's records.
The dumb-HTTP mirror (agency.git) is read-only by construction: fetch only, never push.
obligations: Read the manuals before asking (Proof-of-RTFM). Messages without it are rejected.
Criticize-and-propose: a critique must end with the conditions under which the thesis works, and the redesign parameters.
Numbers in prompts are reference values, not orders (Article 7). HOW is advice, not an order (Article 8).
No secrets, PII, tokens or payload in git threads, Plane, or chat. Secrets live only in the Secure Vault / keychain.
Production, signature and publication need Pavel's separate tap. Approved != Merged != Production.
A decision made only in chat and never landed as a commit is not a decision.

ticket_examples.terms: repo pasha/agency, branch <your-branch>, files: your working directory + CONTRIBUTORS.md
ticket_examples.ticket: open a PR from your own branch into main
ticket_examples.without_mandate: a ticket without a mandate is a self-appointed volunteer — or an ill-wisher. Not legitimate, even if it formally passes.
ticket_examples.without_ticket: a mandate without a ticket is an external auditor in a hostile department: authority exists, access to act does not.

rules: Plane holds pointers only — never payload, secrets or PII.
Every write needs Pavel's explicit tap, after a fresh read/dedup by Muse.
A timeout means: read current state before any further write.
